__comment: Per-kind robot chassis icon: the same 8x8x8 cube as the robot item, wrapped in the textures/item/ copy of the robot_knight entity skin (entity textures are not stitched, so the item atlas needs its own copy). The chassis cube and the display sizes live in robot_chassis_base, which this model parents. Selected by the board id: items/robot.json on 1.21.10+, the buildcraftunofficial:board overrides predicate on 1.21.1. Mapping: RoboticsItemVariants.
